page_copy: Join us for London Builders Night on 12 November at Tech Hub Shoreditch. Bring something you're building, demo it in five minutes and get honest feedback from people who've been there. Pizza, drinks and great company included.

newsletter.subject: You're invited: London Builders Night, 12 Nov
newsletter.body:
Hi there,

We're hosting London Builders Night on Thursday 12 November at 18:30 at Tech Hub Shoreditch.

It's an easy, friendly evening: short demos, useful feedback and a room full of people building interesting things. 84 people are already going.

Save your spot and bring a friend.

See you there,
Aluinn & Sam
